verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe dots as an always-on cloud agent with its own computer that keeps working while your computer is off (dots-docs-1, dots-docs-2). It runs background agents in parallel (dots-docs-8) and supports recurring scheduled automations, such as checking a channel every weekday at 9 AM for four weeks (dots-docs-14). Docs also confirm scheduled runs persist even when the dot is paused (dots-docs-22), and it can monitor a Slack channel for new bug reports and prepare fixes autonomously (dots-docs-15). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of reliable autonomous execution, and documentation of how to list, edit, or cancel scheduled automations.
